description: Classification of all 195 PARK checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 6 PARK guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement - tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance - tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.trail-type-identification: Trail type (one-way shared use, two-way shared use, off-street urban) must be identified to determine applicable width standard
additionalRequirementTypes.signage-verification: Required signage must be verified when design speed reduced
additionalRequirementTypes.usage-volume-verification: Peak hour user volume must be determined to calculate required width increase
additionalRequirementTypes.park-size-verification: Park acreage must be determined to calculate required ROW frontage
